title: LC-MS Quantitation
author: Ryan Sheldon
materials: After solvent addition, vortex each sample for 10s.

steps.title: Prepare External Calibration Curve
steps.instruction: Create a calibration curve starting from a high concentration of drug GNE2861 (HY-12632, MedChemExpress) at 10µg/mL, followed by eight additional points using a half-log serial dilution.

steps.title: Prepare Brain Samples
steps.instruction: Place a hippocampus from each mouse into a bead mill homogenizer tube (19-627, Revvity) and weigh, ensuring the tissue does not thaw.

steps.title: Extract Samples and Standards
steps.instruction: Extract brain samples and 10µl of each calibration curve point using 1 mL of 80% methanol (A456, Fisher Scientific) (v/v) solution.

substeps.instruction: Spike the extraction solution with D3 octanoyl-carnitine (HY-139392S, MedChemExpress) as an internal standard to a final concentration of 5ng/mL.

steps.title: Homogenize and Sonicate
steps.instruction: Process the samples to ensure complete extraction.

substeps.instruction: Homogenize samples for 30s at 6m/s at 6°C ±2°C (cooled via liquid nitrogen).
Sonicate samples for 5min in a water bath sonicator.

steps.title: Incubate and Centrifuge
steps.instruction: Separate the extract from the debris.

substeps.instruction: Incubate samples on wet ice for 1 hour.
Centrifuge for 10 minutes at 4°C at 17,000g.
Transfer 850µl of supernatant to a new 1.5mL Eppendorf Tube.
Centrifuge again to fully clear the precipitate.

steps.title: Dry and Resuspend Extracts
steps.instruction: Concentrate the sample and resuspend in a specific solvent ratio.

substeps.instruction: Collect 800µl of supernatant from the second spin into a fresh 1.5mL Eppendorf tube and dry in a rotary vacuum.
Resuspend dried extracts by adding 40µl of acetonitrile (A955, Fisher Scientific).
Vortex samples for 10 sec.
Sonicate samples for 5 min in a water bath sonicator.
Add 40µl of water solution to each sample to achieve a final resuspension solvent composition of 50/50 acetonitrile/water (v/v).
Repeat the 10 sec vortex and 5 min water bath sonication.

steps.title: Final Sample Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare the final supernatant for injection.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge samples for 10 minutes at 4°C at 17,000g.
Transfer 70µl of supernatant to an autosampler vial with insert (03452247, Thermo Fisher).

steps.title: Configure LC-MS System
steps.instruction: Set up the Agilent 6470 triple quadrupole mass spectrometer and Agilent ultra-high performance liquid chromatography 1290 Infinity II.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Mobile phase A: LC/MS grade water (W6, Fisher) with 0.1% formic acid (A117, Fisher Scientific).
Prepare Mobile phase B: 99% Acetonitrile (A955-4, Fisher), 1% LC/MS grade water (W6, Fisher), and 0.1% formic acid.
Install an Acquity Premier HSS T3 Column (1.8 µm, 2.1mm × 150mm, 186009473, Waters) with a VanGuard cartridge (1.8 µm, 2.1 mm × 5 mm, 186009473, Waters).
Set column temperature to 50 °C and flow rate to 0.4 mL/min.
Set gas flow to 13 L/min at 200°C, sheath gas flow to 12 L/min at 325 °C, and nebulizer to 45 psi.
Set capillary voltage to +3000 and nozzle voltage to +500.

steps.title: Run LC-MS Analysis
steps.instruction: Inject samples and acquire data using dynamic multiple reaction monitoring (dMRM).

substeps.instruction: Inject 2µL of each sample.

Apply the 12-minute gradient: 0-2 min at 0% B; 2-7.1 min ramp from 0 to 99% B; 7.1-9 min hold at 99% B; 9.1-11 min switch to 100% A at 0.6 mL/min; 11.1-12 min reduce flow rate to 0.4 mL/min to stabilize.
Acquire data using dMRM with at least two transitions per compound.

steps.title: Analyze Data
steps.instruction: Perform peak picking and integration using Skyline Software (v 25.1.0.237; RRID:SCR_014080).

substeps.instruction: Use D3 octanoyl-carnitine as an internal standard to assess extraction variability.
Use D8 Tryptophan to measure run-to-run variability.
